facts.fact: Government Notice No. 29 of 2024, the National Identity Card Regulations 2024, were made by the Minister under section 10 of the National Identity Card Act, which they apply, and came into operation on 19 February 2024; the regulations are subsidiary legislation, and the Act is an Act of Parliament.

The National Identity Card Regulations 2024 (Government Notice No. 29 of 2024), made by the Minister on 16 February 2024 under section 10 of the National Identity Card Act, set the new identity card, its digital seal and fingerprint-based application, and revoke the National Identity Card Regulations 2013.
